newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Shell, Oxy units bag gas deal with Philippine firm.
newsitem.headline: Shell, Oxy units bag gas deal with Philippine firm.

text.p: The exploration group of Shell Philippines Exploration BV and Occidental Philippines Inc said on Wednesday it had agreed with National Power Corp to supply the state-owned firm with natural gas starting year 2002.
The agreement says the Shell/Oxy group will supply a total of 1,197 petajoules, or about 60 petajoules of gas per year over the next twenty years.
The group is the operator of the Camago-Malampaya natural gas field in southwestern Philippines.

"The gas will be used for the combined cycle gas turbine power plants with an aggregate capacity of 1,200 megawatt to be built at Ilijan, Batangas," the statement said. Batangas is an industrial province just south of Manila.
The deal is subject to ratification by the National Power Corp's board.
Shell Philippines is the local drilling unit of Royal Dutch/Shell Group. Oxy is a subsidiary of Occidental Petroleum Corp
